subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) EIRV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7d9b12926ef8ce30330a15ab24fc0dc658312d982e979491616f775f0e62096.png] 

Option 2) XBIO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/570f8446d6beeabd9846178f2c52089f95f7b808d26b517a19c62b43be11eb3f.png] 

Option 3) KOVB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96f96abcc0bb9ee8013c1b0e042d604915464366bccbce4f2dc2ce36645e0fcd.png] 

Option 4) AELR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b32057b8272a183fbb40bf75e229e6eb12fb9d08926ff95968b9971f4f1f23a.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'EIRV' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
